tools.name: find_cheapest_tlds
tools.description: List domain extensions (TLDs) with the cheapest registrar for first-year registration, renewal, transfer and 3-year total. Prices in USD/year.

tools.name: get_tld_prices
tools.description: Every registrar’s current register / renew / transfer price for one extension (e.g. "com", "io", "co.in"), cheapest first, plus average and median.

tools.name: compare_tlds
tools.description: Compare registrar prices across up to 20 extensions side by side.

tools.name: get_tld_price_history
tools.description: Per-registrar registration and renewal price history for one extension.

tools.name: list_promo_codes
tools.description: Currently active registrar promo/coupon codes, biggest discount first.

tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Live availability check for a full domain name (RDAP, WHOIS fallback). available is null if the registry could not be reached.

tools.name: list_registrars
tools.description: Every domain registrar TLDers tracks, with WHOIS-privacy info and number of tracked TLDs.
